newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Cyrix up after merger.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Cyrix up after merger.

text.p: Cyrix Corp shares were up 2 from an unofficial close of 23-1/16 in after hours trading, after National Semiconductor to merge with the company for about $550 million in stock, traders said Monday.
"They're looking at a target of 27 and change, based on what's coming over the ticker now," one trader said.
Trading in Cyrix shares was later halted after National Semiconductor revealed the merger plans. National Semiconductor is offering Cyrix holders 0.825 shares of its stock for each share of Cyrix.
The announcement came shortly after the close of the regular session.
Shares of National Semiconductor were down 1/16 in after hours trading from an unofficial close of 33-7/16, another trader said.
"It traded as low as 32-1/2 and worked its way up again. It's really kind of all over the map," he said.
Dealers said there was little activity among other stocks.
Advanced Micro Devices shares were up just 1/8 from a close of 35-3/8, after the company announced price cuts on its K6 computer chips in response price cuts announced earlier Monday by Intel Corp.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 500 shares, compared to 40,400 Friday, and session two had 3.2 million shares, compared to 1.8 million Friday.
